My goal is to show you how aesthetics can be used to unlock value and help businesses succeed.

In this book, I make four fundamental points: (1) aesthetics matter in business (and beyond); (2) aesthetic intelligence can be cultivated; in fact, each of us possesses far more capacity than we use; (3) aesthetic vision and leadership have the power to transform companies and even entire sectors; and (4) in the absence of aesthetics, most businesses are susceptible to potentially fatal challenges.
